purpose: Fixed local VoxCPM2, VieNeu and experimental F5-TTS reference conditioning for Hina speech output

provenance.origin: Owner-generated synthetic voice created with ElevenLabs
provenance.ownerRightsStatement: On 2026-07-25 the repository owner stated that the source voice was generated entirely by AI in ElevenLabs and that no third-party voice permission is required.

f5Reference.referenceTranscript: Xin chào mọi người, Hina có mặt rồi đây, hôm nay mọi người đi làm, đi học về có mệt lắm không? Cứ từ từ pha một ly nước ấm, rồi ngồi xuống đây tâm sự với mình nhé.

consent.deletionProcedure: Delete the reference WAV and this manifest, then remove the configured Hina reference voice.

processing.method: Zero-shot VoxCPM2/VieNeu/F5-TTS reference conditioning at runtime; no model-weight training or fine-tuning

restrictions: VoxCPM2 output is not watermarked and must not be exposed as a public voice-cloning service
